profile.headline: Software Developer at Federal Reserve Information Technology
profile.summary:
Software development professional with experience managing teams and projects.  Flexibility to learn new technologies and take technology initiatives from concept to completion.  Professional and personal interests in web applications, Flash/Flex development, and streaming media.

Specialties: SaaS solutions, Flash, Flex, streaming media, web applications, web design, software engineering, project management, team leadership, object oriented programming, databases

positions.title: Director of Product Development
positions.description: Managed development efforts and built SaaS solutions for the staffing industry.  Responsible for delivering innovative timeshEASY product to numerous clients across North America.

positions.title: Director of Systems Development - Vcall
positions.description: Responsible for the Flash webcasting platform architecture and strategic direction.  Served as a lead developer on the project as well as managing other developers focused on internal infrastructure.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Web application/design and database consulting for Core clients in Richmond.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Managed developer activities and project schedules for scoring and front desk client/server software applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developer responsible for point-of-sale, scoring, and bowling center management software products.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer/Programmer
positions.description: Developed software for holography systems and high speed manufacturing equipment.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for holography systems, machine and motor control.  Generated electrical schematics.
